```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
```

## 1. University of Miami Shark Survey Data

```{r}
#| label: load-sharks
sharks_by_set <- read_csv("data/miami_sharks/SharksBySet.csv")
shark_lengths <- read_csv("data/miami_sharks/TotalLengthAndSex.csv")
shark_recaps  <- read_csv("data/miami_sharks/OriginalAndRecaptureLocations.csv")

glimpse(sharks_by_set)
```

## 2. Florida FWC Red Tide Monitoring Data (2007–Present)

```{r}
#| label: load-fwc
# List all FWC CSV files and read them into one combined tibble
fwc_files <- list.files("data/fwc_redtide", pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
fwc_redtide <- read_csv(fwc_files, col_types = cols(TIME = col_character()))

glimpse(fwc_redtide)
```

## 3. NOAA HABSOS Harmful Algal Bloom Data

```{r}
#| label: load-noaa
noaa_habsos <- read_csv("data/noaa_habsos/noaa_habsos_cell_counts.csv")

glimpse(noaa_habsos)
```
